name: Phyllo Creator Economy API
description: Phyllo provides a unified API for accessing creator economy data across social media and commerce platforms. It enables retrieval of creator identity, engagement metrics, income transactions, and audience demographics from platforms like YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, and more.
